'''Pitt Onoran''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[human]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the lead-up to the [[Galactic Civil War]]. Initially a logistics officer with the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]], he later joined the Rebel Alliance during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], and with the rank of [[general]] headed the [[Rebel Alliance Special Forces]] division attached to the [[Massassi Group|unit]] on [[Yavin 4]]'s [[Great Temple|Base One]].<ref name="UVG" /> He, along with [[Taidu Sefla]], provided a report to [[Mon Mothma]] on the capabilities of various ground vehicles available to the Alliance. He also supplied a document with his assessment of the [[Imperial Military]]'s ground assault vehicles.<ref name="rebelfiles">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>
